answer_text: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN usually means the IPSec phase-1/phase-2 transforms on the Cato side don’t match what AWS VGW is offering. Check the tunnel timeline in CMA for the NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN event and review the logs for p1/p2 transform mismatches (e.g., “The chosen P1 transform is XXX... doesn’t match the current configuration” or “No supported p2 transform”). Use CMA’s IPsec site connectivity troubleshooting and the built-in packet capture tool to collect control traffic and compare the negotiated transforms. Also verify that AWS’s default IPsec settings match Cato’s recommended AWS settings; if a change occurred during maintenance, ensure both sides are aligned with the same phase 1 and phase 2 transforms.
